df_2013 = Table_2.query("budget == 'M14 Ville' and sens_depense_recette == 'Dépenses' and exercice_comptable == 2013")
avg_2013 = (
    df_2013.groupby('type_d_operation_r_o_i_m')['mandate_titre_apres_regul']
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'mandate_titre_apres_regul': 'avg_2013'})
)
df_2018 = Table_0.query("budget == 'M57 Ville' and sens_depense_recette == 'Dépenses' and exercice_comptable == 2018")
avg_2018 = (
    df_2018.groupby('type_d_operation_r_o_i_m')['budgets_votes_pmt']
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'budgets_votes_pmt': 'avg_2018'})
)
df_2021 = Table_1.query("budget == 'M57 Ville' and sens_depense_recette == 'Dépenses' and exercice_comptable == 2021")
avg_2021 = (
    df_2021.groupby('type_d_operation_r_o_i_m')['budget_vote_pmt']
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'budget_vote_pmt': 'avg_2021'})
)
merged = (
    avg_2013.merge(avg_2018, on='type_d_operation_r_o_i_m', how='inner')
    .merge(avg_2021, on='type_d_operation_r_o_i_m', how='inner')
)
merged['increase'] = merged['avg_2021'] - merged['avg_2013']
merged['rank'] = merged['increase'].rank(method='dense', ascending=False).astype(int)
result = merged[['type_d_operation_r_o_i_m', 'avg_2013', 'avg_2018', 'avg_2021', 'increase', 'rank']]
cases.expected_result_description: One row per operation type (Investissement, Pour Ordre, Réel) with columns avg_2013, avg_2018, avg_2021, increase (avg_2021 - avg_2013) and rank (1 = largest increase).

cases.question: Quel est le montant total voté et le montant total autorisé du programme pour AP de Projet fonds dans le budget principal 2018, et quelle est la différence entre les deux telle qu'indiquée dans le texte administratif ?
cases.reference_code:
import pandas as pd
t0_agg = (
    Table_0
    .loc[
        (Table_0['exercice_comptable'] == 2018) &
        (Table_0['sens_depense_recette'].str.lower() == 'dépenses') &
        (Table_0['budget'].str.lower() == 'm57 ville')
    ]
    .groupby(['exercice_comptable', 'budget', 'sens_depense_recette'], as_index=False)
    .agg(voted_total=('budgets_votes_pmt', 'sum'))
)
t2_agg = (
    Table_2
    .loc[
        (Table_2['exercice_comptable'] == 2018) &
        (Table_2['sens_depense_recette'].str.lower() == 'dépenses') &
        (Table_2['budget'].str.lower() == 'm57 ville') &
        (Table_2['type_de_fonds'].fillna('').str.lower() == 'ap de projet')
    ]
    .groupby(['exercice_comptable', 'budget', 'sens_depense_recette'], as_index=False)
    .agg(authorized_total=('budgets_votes_eng', 'sum'))
)
t1_agg = (
    Table_1
    .loc[
        (Table_1['exercice_comptable_cle_non_composee'] == 2018) &
        (Table_1['sens_depense_recette_texte'].str.lower() == 'dépenses')
    ]
    .groupby(['exercice_comptable_cle_non_composee', 'sens_depense_recette_texte'], as_index=False)
    .agg(admin_total=('mandate_titre_x000d_apres_regul', 'sum'))
)
merged = (
    t0_agg
    .merge(
        t2_agg,
        on=['exercice_comptable', 'budget', 'sens_depense_recette'],
        how='inner',
        suffixes=('', '_2')
    )
    .merge(
        t1_agg,
        left_on=['exercice_comptable', 'sens_depense_recette'],
        right_on=['exercice_comptable_cle_non_composee', 'sens_depense_recette_texte'],
        how='inner',
        suffixes=('', '_1')
    )
)
merged['difference'] = merged['authorized_total'] - merged['voted_total']
result = merged[['voted_total', 'authorized_total', 'admin_total', 'difference']]
cases.expected_result_description: A single‑row table with four columns: voted_total (total voted amount), authorized_total (total authorized program amount for AP de Projet fonds), admin_total (total amount shown in the administrative texte), and difference (authorized_total minus voted_total).
